name: play
description: Plays a track immediately (clears the queue). Resolves plain text search queries or plays from local cache. Pass the user's requested song title/artist directly.

query.description: A plain text search query (e.g., 'Rick Astley Never Gonna Give You Up' or 'classical jazz'). Do not guess or generate video IDs or URLs.

name: queue
description: Appends a track to the end of the current queue. Playback starts immediately if nothing is currently playing.

query.description: A plain text search query (e.g., 'Lofi hip hop mix'). Do not guess or generate video IDs or URLs.

name: play_next
description: Queues a track at the very front of the queue to be played immediately after the current song finishes.

query.description: A plain text search query (e.g., 'Blinding Lights'). Do not guess or generate video IDs or URLs.

name: resume
description: Resumes current media playback if paused.

name: stop
description: Stops all playback and fully clears the playback state, queue, and autoplay pool.

name: next
description: Skips the current track and advances to the next track in the queue or autoplay pool.

name: previous
description: Returns playback to the previous track from history.

name: seek
description: Seeks to a specific position in seconds within the current track.

seconds.description: Position in seconds to seek to.

name: volume
description: Adjusts the volume level of the player.

name: mute
description: Toggles the mute state on or off.

name: shuffle
description: Randomizes the order of all tracks currently in the manual play queue.

name: clear
description: Clears all tracks from the manual play queue.

name: autoplay
description: Enables or disables autoplay recommendations when the manual queue runs dry.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable autoplay, or false to disable it.
